# GEM-15: Surface and Terrain Elevation at 15 m

> Google Research's experimental near-global 15 m elevation dataset, from
> sub-meter optical stereo imagery: a Digital Surface Model (5 bands) and a
> co-registered bare-earth Digital Terrain Model (1 band). This is a Portolan
> metadata mirror. The elevation COGs stay in Google's public bucket; this
> catalog adds an item index, an overview, terrain tiles, styles and docs.

Key facts

- 13,485 one-degree cells, 26,970 Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs, about 12.3 TB.
- Coverage 84°N to 61°S. No Russia, China, Mongolia, Greenland or Antarctica.
- About 2.5 % of cells are masked, in all six bands. Heights over India are
  deliberately offset.
- Float32, metres, nodata NaN, 15 m grid, each cell in its own local UTM zone.
- Heights are orthometric on the **EGM96 geoid (EPSG:5773)**, not ellipsoidal
  and not EGM2008. Convert before mixing with GLO-30, FABDEM or NASADEM.
- DSM band order: `dsm`, `dsm_percentile_5`, `dsm_percentile_50`,
  `dsm_percentile_95`, `dsm_std`. Band 1 is `dsm`. The COG carries no band names.
- Height above ground is `dsm − dtm`. The DTM never exceeds the DSM at full
  resolution.
- DSM accuracy: 3.37 m mean debiased RMSE against airborne lidar, against 3.85 m
  for Copernicus GLO-30. The DTM is weaker than FABDEM under closed canopy.
- Item `datetime` is a processing timestamp (2026-09-29), not an acquisition
  date. No per-cell acquisition date is published.
- Google's bucket serves range requests but sends no CORS headers, so browsers
  cannot read the COGs. Use this catalog's terrain tiles and overview instead.
- License CC-BY-4.0. Required attribution: "This dataset is produced by Google".

Key URLs

- Collection: https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/gem-15-catalog/gem-15/collection.json
- Item index (STAC-GeoParquet, all 13,485 items): https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/gem-15-catalog/gem-15/items.parquet
- Global overview COG: https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/gem-15-catalog/gem-15/gem-15_overview.tif
- Terrain tiles (terrarium PMTiles, z0–z13): https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/gem-15-catalog/gem-15/terrain/gem-15-dsm-terrarium.pmtiles
- Upstream COGs and STAC: https://storage.googleapis.com/climate-and-sustainability/gem-15/
- Earth Engine entry: https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/projects_climate-and-sustainability_assets_gem-15_v1
- Preprint: https://doi.org/10.31223/X55N75

Documentation

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): cell naming, runnable DuckDB and GDAL recipes, band
  semantics, and the quirks that produce silently wrong answers. Read this first
  if you are writing a query.
- [README.md](README.md): what the data is, a quick start, suggested uses,
  limitations, accuracy tables, and the MapLibre terrain story.
- [collection.json](collection.json): STAC 1.1 metadata, `item_assets`,
  `renders`, and 297 `child` links into Google's STAC tree.
